invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Pair object, constructed at the end.
The left element, partitionPathStatMap, is always instantiated as a HashMap.
The right element, globalStat, is always instantiated.
All WorkloadStat values put into the map are non-null as new WorkloadStat is always assigned.
The method expects inputRecords to be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
